note: Calibration rules: REAL observations -> DERIVED starting values. Every rule is documented in research/data/VARIABLE_INVENTORY.md section B. Variables absent from 'rules' keep the neutral default and status UNCALIBRATED.

by_design_neutral.price_level: Index defined as 100 at game start.
by_design_neutral.damage: No unrecovered simulated damage at game start.
by_design_neutral.sentiment_base: No official measure of regional support for a fictional president exists; deriving it from proxies risks stereotyping regions.
by_design_neutral.trust: Starts neutral for the same reason as sentiment_base.
by_design_neutral.flood_protection: Additional flood protection built during the term. Baseline protective capacity is already embedded in the IRBI risk score used for flood_exposure, so starting at 0 avoids double counting.
by_design_neutral.fire_prevention: Additional prevention built during the term; baseline capacity is not measured (no official kab/kota index ingested).
by_design_neutral.food_supply: Computed every tick from food capacity, logistics and damage; the starting value is overwritten in the first month.

flood_risk_profile.doc: DERIVED baseline flood risk profile = 100 x official IRBI 2024 flood risk score / 36. NOT an official BNPB percentage. Missing IRBI -> neutral 50, UNCALIBRATED. Used only as a severity (vulnerability/capacity) modifier.

flood_frequency.doc: Expected recorded flood events per year: Gamma-Poisson empirical-Bayes rate over all observed BNPB years; province prior; never 0 by default. Production years are pinned explicitly; a multi-year candidate replaces them only after scripts/pipelines/calibration/compare_flood_frequency.py has been reviewed (D-037).
